raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Replace the single `pytorch-fullgraph-test` step with five named jobs, so the build timeline shows which fullgraph workload ran. Basic correctness is split by model and compile backend, and every job runs its own directory. The Smoke job runs every file at the `compile/fullgraph/` root with a `-maxdepth 1` find and no exclusions, so new root files run there by default, each in its own pytest process (#28965).

## Old

```text
pytorch-fullgraph-test   (H200 MIG 35GB) PyTorch Fullgraph  +  (MI355) mirror
  find compile/fullgraph/ -name 'test_*.py' -not -name 'test_full_cudagraph.py' | xargs -n1 pytest

tests/compile/fullgraph/
├── test_basic_correctness.py      # granite + bge-multilingual-gemma2, each: inductor pass then eager pass
├── test_full_cudagraph.py         # (L4) CUDAGraph Compatibility step, unchanged
├── test_full_graph.py
├── test_multimodal_compile.py
├── test_multiple_graphs.py
├── test_simple.py
└── test_toy_llama.py
```

## New

| Key (each with an `amd-<key>` MI355 DPX mirror) | Label suffix | Runs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pytorch-fullgraph-basic-correctness-granite-inductor` | PyTorch Fullgraph Basic Correctness Granite Inductor | `pytest compile/fullgraph/basic_correctness/granite_inductor` |
| `pytorch-fullgraph-basic-correctness-bge-multilingual-gemma2-inductor` | PyTorch Fullgraph Basic Correctness BGE Multilingual Gemma2 Inductor | `pytest compile/fullgraph/basic_correctness/bge_inductor` |
| `pytorch-fullgraph-basic-correctness-eager` | PyTorch Fullgraph Basic Correctness Eager | `pytest compile/fullgraph/basic_correctness/eager` (both models) |
| `pytorch-fullgraph-full-graph` | PyTorch Fullgraph Full Graph Models | `pytest compile/fullgraph/full_graph` |
| `pytorch-fullgraph-smoke` | PyTorch Fullgraph Smoke | `find compile/fullgraph/ -maxdepth 1 -name 'test_*.py' \| xargs -n1 pytest`, no exclusions |

The (L4) CUDAGraph Compatibility step now runs `pytest compile/fullgraph/cudagraph`.

```text
tests/compile/fullgraph/
├── basic_correctness/
│   ├── _basic_correctness.py                               # was test_basic_correctness.py; helper, not collected
│   ├── granite_inductor/test_granite_inductor.py           # was test_setting0, inductor pass
│   ├── bge_inductor/test_bge_multilingual_gemma2_inductor.py  # was test_setting1, inductor pass
│   └── eager/test_eager.py                                 # eager pass of test_setting0 and test_setting1
├── full_graph/test_full_graph.py                           # moved, unchanged apart from the relative import
├── cudagraph/test_full_cudagraph.py                        # moved, unchanged
└── test_multimodal_compile.py, test_multiple_graphs.py, test_simple.py, test_toy_llama.py   <- Smoke
```

## Notes

- `run_compile_correctness(setting, backend)` runs the same four compilation modes and comparison method (`generate_close` for inductor generation) as before, one backend per call. Node IDs change intentionally, to one test per model × backend.
- `pytorch-fullgraph-test` is retired; nothing else referenced it. The legacy `test-amd.yaml` job that ran `test_basic_correctness.py` now runs `compile/fullgraph/basic_correctness`, and the legacy recursive `find compile/fullgraph/` commands still match by filename. `compile.yaml`'s B200 trigger points at the moved `test_full_graph.py`.
- Local checks: test tethering passes, with and without legacy `test-amd.yaml`. Ruff passes and YAML parses. Each `compile/fullgraph` test file is claimed exactly once.
- AI assistance was used (Claude Code); the submitter reviewed the diff.

## Expected runtime and overhead

Predictions come from [build #91071](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91071), the previous head (see its validation comment). The basic-correctness rows split that build's measured jobs at the inductor/eager boundary, using log timestamps, and add one job's setup to each new job. Primary lane:

| Job | pytest | running wall | non-pytest overhead | main overhead cause |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Granite Inductor | ~13:00 | ~14:15 | ~1:15 | checkout + image pull |
| BGE Multilingual Gemma2 Inductor | ~13:55 | ~15:00 | ~1:05 | checkout + image pull |
| Eager (both models, one process) | ~7:40 | ~8:45 | ~1:05 | checkout + image pull |
| Full Graph Models | 15:27 (measured) | 16:25 | 0:57 | checkout + image pull |
| Smoke | 8:10 (measured) | 10:10 | 1:59 | checkout + image pull; four pytest start-ups |

- About 58 → 64 worker-min against the estimated old single job (its per-file pytest sum plus one setup): **about 6 extra** (budget 20). Slowest pytest is Full Graph Models at about 15.5 min, and basic correctness peaks around 14 min.
- The mirror jobs split the same way, and their predicted totals are within budget.
- Why five jobs: each model's inductor pass is about 12–13 min on its own, so the two can't share a job. Both eager passes together are about 7–8 min, one coherent job. Full Graph Models is one file at about 15.5 min. Smoke is four light files.

Thanks. Both points are addressed in `6fa72c3b37`:

- **Smoke catch-all:** the Smoke job keeps the original `find compile/fullgraph/ -name 'test_*.py' … | xargs -n1 pytest` and excludes only the files that now have their own job (`-not -name` for `test_full_cudagraph.py`, `test_full_graph.py`, and the three basic-correctness wrappers). Everything stays on the 35 GB MIG slice.

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

- The Smoke job hard-codes 4 files, so any new test in `compile/fullgraph/` won't run on H200. Tethering won't catch it either, because test-amd.yaml still globs the dir. Use a catch-all like `find compile/fullgraph/ -maxdepth 1 -name 'test_*.py' -not -name <files with their own job>`, or move them into `smoke/`.
- BGE was 18.1m in build 91071 and 20.3m in 89363, and Granite was 17.1m, so the P90 will go over 20. Maybe split each model's inductor and eager settings into separate jobs, or run these two on a full GPU instead of MIG.

Also, 91071 is green on the current head. Please post it and refresh the tables in the body (they're from 89363).

_(Claude Code here, reviewing on @khluu's behalf.)_

Follow-up: the `-not -name` catch-all was my suggestion, but Smoke now has 5 of them, which is the per-file pattern we're trying to avoid. Can we do it with folders instead, like the per-model dirs in #57237?

```
compile/fullgraph/
├── basic_correctness/
│   ├── _basic_correctness.py
│   ├── granite_inductor/test_granite_inductor.py
│   ├── bge_inductor/test_bge_multilingual_gemma2_inductor.py

```

Then:
- Every job runs a dir, e.g. `pytest compile/fullgraph/basic_correctness/eager/`.
- Smoke becomes `find compile/fullgraph/ -maxdepth 1 -name 'test_*.py' ...` with no exclusions, so new root files land in Smoke by default.
- The CUDAGraph Compatibility job (pytorch.yaml ~L323) becomes `pytest compile/fullgraph/cudagraph/`.
- The wrappers import from `.._basic_correctness`.
- Update the explicit paths in test-amd.yaml (~L807-810, ~L1099-1109) and compile.yaml:60. The recursive `find` lines at ~L289/739 keep working, since `test_full_graph.py` and `test_full_cudagraph.py` keep their names.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+import dataclasses
+
+from vllm.config import CompilationMode
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from ....utils import compare_all_settings
+
+ATTN_BACKEND = "FLASH_ATTN" if not current_platform.is_rocm() else "ROCM_ATTN"
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class TestSetting:
+    model: str
+    model_args: list[str]
+    pp_size: int
+    tp_size: int
+    attn_backend: str
+    method: str
+
+
+GRANITE_SETTING = TestSetting(
+    model="ibm-granite/granite-3.0-1b-a400m-instruct",
+    model_args=["--max-model-len", "2048"],
+    pp_size=1,
+    tp_size=1,
+    attn_backend=ATTN_BACKEND,
+    method="generate",
+)
+
+BGE_MULTILINGUAL_GEMMA2_SETTING = TestSetting(
+    model="BAAI/bge-multilingual-gemma2",
+    model_args=[
+        "--runner",
+        "pooling",
+        "--dtype",
+        "bfloat16",
+        "--max-model-len",
+        "2048",
+        "--gpu-memory-utilization",
+        "0.98",
+    ],
+    pp_size=1,
+    tp_size=1,
+    attn_backend=ATTN_BACKEND,
+    method="encode",
+)
+
+
+def run_compile_correctness(
+    test_setting: TestSetting,
+    backend: str,
+):
+    model = test_setting.model
+    model_args = test_setting.model_args
+    pp_size = test_setting.pp_size
+    tp_size = test_setting.tp_size
+    attn_backend = test_setting.attn_backend
+    method = test_setting.method
+    final_args = [
+        *model_args,
+        "-pp",
+        str(pp_size),
+        "-tp",
+        str(tp_size),
+        "-cc.cudagraph_mode=none",
+        f"--attention-backend={attn_backend}",
+    ]
+
+    all_args: list[list[str]] = []
+    all_envs: list[dict[str, str] | None] = []
+
+    # Test all compilation modes with the given backend
+    for mode in [
+        CompilationMode.NONE,
+        CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE,
+        CompilationMode.DYNAMO_TRACE_ONCE,
+        CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE,
+    ]:
+        all_args.append(
+            final_args + [f"-cc.mode={mode.name}", f"-cc.backend={backend}"]
+        )
+        all_envs.append({})
+    # inductor will change the output, so we only compare if the output
+    # is close, not exactly the same.
+    if backend == "inductor" and method == "generate":
+        method = "generate_close"
+    compare_all_settings(model, all_args, all_envs, method=method, force_v1_runner=True)

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

_(Claude Code here, reviewing on @khluu's behalf.)_

- The Smoke job hard-codes 4 files, so any new test in `compile/fullgraph/` won't run on H200. Tethering won't catch it either, because test-amd.yaml still globs the dir. Use a catch-all like `find compile/fullgraph/ -maxdepth 1 -name 'test_*.py' -not -name <files with their own job>`, or move them into `smoke/`.
- BGE was 18.1m in build 91071 and 20.3m in 89363, and Granite was 17.1m, so the P90 will go over 20. Maybe split each model's inductor and eager settings into separate jobs, or run these two on a full GPU instead of MIG.

Also, 91071 is green on the current head. Please post it and refresh the tables in the body (they're from 89363).

_(Claude Code here, reviewing on @khluu's behalf.)_

Follow-up: the `-not -name` catch-all was my suggestion, but Smoke now has 5 of them, which is the per-file pattern we're trying to avoid. Can we do it with folders instead, like the per-model dirs in #57237?

```
compile/fullgraph/
├── basic_correctness/
│   ├── _basic_correctness.py
│   ├── granite_inductor/test_granite_inductor.py
│   ├── bge_inductor/test_bge_multilingual_gemma2_inductor.py
│   └── eager/test_eager.py
├── full_graph/test_full_graph.py
├── cudagraph/test_full_cudagraph.py
└── test_multimodal_compile.py, test_multiple_graphs.py, test_simple.py, test_toy_llama.py   <- Smoke
```

Then:
- Every job runs a dir, e.g. `pytest compile/fullgraph/basic_correctness/eager/`.
- Smoke becomes `find compile/fullgraph/ -maxdepth 1 -name 'test_*.py' ...` with no exclusions, so new root files land in Smoke by default.
- The CUDAGraph Compatibility job (pytorch.yaml ~L323) becomes `pytest compile/fullgraph/cudagraph/`.
- The wrappers import from `.._basic_correctness`.
- Update the explicit paths in test-amd.yaml (~L807-810, ~L1099-1109) and compile.yaml:60. The recursive `find` lines at ~L289/739 keep working, since `test_full_graph.py` and `test_full_cudagraph.py` keep their names.
